title: Unforeseen Utility Clash to Approved Change Order Workflow

input.scenario: Excavator discovers uncharted utility duct bank interfering with 33kV high voltage route.

stages.details: Site engineer uploads photo of uncovered brick conduit with GPS tags.
Contractor raises RFI-2026-001; engineer issues SK-S-201-A directing 1200mm bypass route.
Employer PM sends email directing immediate relocation prior to formal pricing.
Contractor drafts and submits CO-2026-002 for $88,750 USD with 4 days time impact.
Risk engine verifies no duplicate claims and confirms linked RFI evidence.
Commercial manager reviews grounded evidence and approves change order.

title: Cost Outlier Detection, Rejection & Revised Approval Workflow

input.scenario: Contractor submits variation with concrete unit rate >20% above BOQ baseline.

stages.details: Baseline BOQ item ST-01 established at USD 210.00/m3.
Contractor submits variation claiming USD 380.00/m3 for identical concrete.
Risk engine triggers 'cost_outlier' (>20% over baseline rate $210/m3), exposure $34,000 USD.
Commercial manager rejects submission citing BOQ-2026-CS-01 item ST-01.
Contractor resubmits at agreed rate USD 225.00/m3 (within allowable adjustment). Approved.

title: Insufficient Evidence Refusal, Evidence Upload & Final Resolution

input.scenario: Rock excavation claim initially lacks borehole and surveyor evidence; system refuses approval until uploaded.

stages.details: Claim submitted for $85,000 rock excavation without supporting survey logs.
System blocks approval with status 'insufficient_evidence', citing missing survey cross sections.
Contractor uploads certified surveyor volume cross-section survey and geotechnical core log.
Evidence links established to Document ID. Status transitions from insufficient_evidence to open.
Commercial manager confirms survey volume 1,000m3 and certifies payment.

title: Conflicting Weather Evidence Audit and Partial Claim Adjustment

input.scenario: Contractor files weather delay claim contradicted by project's own daily site log.

stages.details: Daily report records clear sunny weather and ongoing concrete works.
Contractor submits claim for 3 days weather disruption on same date.
Engine flags 'conflicting_information' with dual source citations.
Commercial team presents daily report logs; contractor withdraws weather delay claim.

title: Grounded Multi-Turn Investigation Agent Workflow with Citation Verification

input.scenario: Commercial Director queries investigation agent for foundation variation exposure.

stages.query: What is the total approved financial exposure for foundation and dewatering variations on Project Apex Horizon?

stages.details: Investigation agent executes scoped hybrid search across tenant and project boundaries.
Agent retrieves CO-2026-001 ($142,500) and CO-2026-005 ($118,900) with source document IDs and page numbers.
Agent computes sum of $261,400.00 USD, explicitly citing Page 1 of CO-2026-001 and Page 1 of CO-2026-005, refusing to extrapolate ungrounded estimates.
